ValidationRule.description: The Daily Stand Up Meeting can be created, if the related Project Status is "In Progress" and that the Daily Date corresponds to the period indicated in the actual dates.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT( $Setup.Org_Exceptions__c.Bypass_Validation_rules__c ),OR( ISBLANK(Project__r.PF_Actual_Start_Date__c), Project__r.PF_Actual_End_Date__c <= TODAY(), NOT(ISPICKVAL( Project__r.PF_Project_Status__c , "In Progress")) ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Daily Stand Up Meeting cannot be created. Verify if the related Project Status is "In Progress" and that the Daily Date corresponds to the period indicated in the actual dates.
